text.content:
The Lady of Westbrook. Tea first, business after.

Role: Fixer (Fixer 8)
Affiliation: Works with the Tyger Claws, not for them
Where to find them: A pachinko parlor on Jig-Jig Street, Japantown
Known for: Every kind of gig; Westbrook's top fixer

Westbrook's top fixer, nearly as old as Lyle Thompson and twice as mean. She runs her business out of a pachinko parlor in Japantown, works alongside the Tyger Claws without answering to them, and serves tea before business. Her gigs cover every kind of work, and she was one of the few to keep helping Papa Sunrise's children after he vanished.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.27; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.09
